newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent around close, gas oil futures supports.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent around close, gas oil futures supports.

text.p: Crude futures prices in Asia were trading around Friday's close in late trading on Monday, with a firmer-than-expected start to gas oil trading in London offering support.
March Brent futures, trading on SIMEX, last traded at $22.30 per barrel, up four cents from London's settlement. March has traded a range of $22.23 to $22.30.
April traded two cents higher at $21.88.

Brokers said they expected Brent to trade sideways on Monday as player seek a direction, although bears might be tempted to target the December low of $22.00 after breaking support at $22.30 in London on Friday.
One broker said the downside was still a struggle despite the recent decline.
"It's testing numbers and then rebounding rather quickly," he said.
March NYMEX crude was last traded at $24.05 per barrel, unchanged from the New York close.
